label: 指定章节已按时向读者提供
description: 内容访问请求（request.access）与订阅合同（contract.subscription）匹配，读者凭访问所需付款证明（role.access-payment）或免费恢复资格证明（role.access-restored）具备版本资格，并在期限内恰有一份匹配的内容提供凭证（confirmation.access）时，判定内容访问履约（fulfillment.access）完成。
expression:
request.subscription_id == agreement.subscription_id &&
request.reader_id == agreement.reader_id && request.column_id ==
agreement.column_id && ((payments.exists(p, p.subscription_id ==
agreement.subscription_id && p.reader_id == agreement.reader_id &&
p.column_id == agreement.column_id && p.amount_minor_units ==
agreement.amount_minor_units && p.currency == agreement.currency &&
p.success && p.confirmed_at >= agreement.signed_at && p.confirmed_at
<= agreement.signed_at + duration(string(agreement.payment_seconds)
+ "s")) && !(refunds.exists(p, p.subscription_id ==
request.subscription_id && p.reader_id == request.reader_id &&
p.column_id == request.column_id && p.settled &&
p.amount_minor_units == agreement.amount_minor_units && p.currency
== agreement.currency && p.confirmed_at <= request.started_at)) &&
request.edition_id == agreement.edition_id) ||
restorations.exists(p, p.subscription_id == request.subscription_id
&& p.reader_id == request.reader_id && p.column_id ==
request.column_id && p.edition_id == request.edition_id &&
p.charged_minor_units == 0 && p.restored && p.confirmed_at <=
request.started_at)) && confirmations.filter(c, c.request_id ==
request.request_id && c.subscription_id == request.subscription_id
&& c.reader_id == request.reader_id && c.column_id ==
request.column_id && c.confirmed_at >= request.started_at &&
c.confirmed_at <= request.expired_at && c.chapter_id ==
request.chapter_id && c.edition_id == request.edition_id &&
c.delivered).size() == 1
